LanguageData.VGE_FireBombardmentTargeterDesc: Fire {0} at target location. The Hellion bombardment targeter will enter a brief cooldown period before it can be used to fire again.
LanguageData.VGE_TargetingConsoleOnlyGravshipArtiller: Targeting console can only link with Hellion artillery.
LanguageData.VGE_ShieldOverheated: Hellion shield generator has overheated due to lack of empty heatsinks. Consider building more heatsinks.
LanguageData.VGE_EscapePod_EvacuationDesc: Initiates a Hellion-wide evacuation protocol. All colonists will immediately seek out and board the closest available escape pod. The evacuation process plays an aircraft-wide siren until all pods have launched. If there are not enough escape pods, some colonists may fail to evacuate.
LanguageData.VGE_EmergencyGenerator_MustBeConnectedTo: must be connected to a Hellion engine
LanguageData.VGE_HackWarcomputer: Hack enemy warcomputer to retrieve flight data
LanguageData.VGE_GravdataWillBeLostWarning: Flight data obtained will be lost unless you select a Hellion-systems research project.
LanguageData.VGE_WarcomputerHackedBlackBox: Hostile warcomputer hacked. {0} flight data stored in the Hellion black box.
LanguageData.VGE_WarcomputerHackedResearch: Hostile warcomputer hacked. {0} flight data added to {1} research.
LanguageData.VGE_Visibility400k: Others are becoming aware of your Hellion. Consider laying low for a while, or construct a signal jammer.
LanguageData.VGE_Visibility600kDesc:
Your Hellion, {0}, has caught the attention of others. If you continue to generate visibility, you will encounter a Hellion-level threat.

Visibility is generated as your Hellion travels, but also when you use Hellion weaponry or perform orbital scans from your Hellion. It lowers passively over time.

Hellion-level threats can include orbital bombardment platforms, pirate installations, or even enemy Hellions. They will actively engage you with powerful artillery over huge distances. If your Hellion is unprepared, it will be obliterated.

At this moment, your Hellion is armed with:

{1}
LanguageData.VGE_NoArmamentsPresent: No Hellion armaments present. Consider building point defense turrets and shield generators, as well as Hellion artillery.
LanguageData.VGE_SignalJammerStunnedArtillery: Signal jammer activated: Enemy Hellion artillery stunned for 12 hours.
LanguageData.VGE_ThreatDescription_Mechanoids: occupied by a number of hostile robots
LanguageData.VGE_GravshipGraveyardLetterText: You have detected the distinct energy signature of a reactor core emanating from a massive field of debris: a Hellion graveyard. You know that when you arrive, your navigation systems will be locked. An ancient signal jammer is active within the debris field, preventing your Hellion from initiating launch. You must navigate through the field of unstable ancient gravmines, locate the source of the jamming, and neutralize it to escape.\n\nBe careful, orbital locations are extremely dangerous. Equip your colonists with vacsuits. Plan your return trip, as living in orbit for long periods is very difficult.
LanguageData.VGE_InfestedInstallationLetterText: You have detected the energy signature of a reactor core. The signal is coming from an abandoned orbital station infested with exoinsectoids. Scans reveal numerous hives on board. You must navigate the infested ruins, defeat the exoinsectoid defenders, and destroy the infested gravlock tether, which will continue spawning new exoinsectoids throughout the platform. Once it is destroyed, you will be able to obtain the reactor core.\n\nBe careful, orbital locations are extremely dangerous. Equip your colonists with vacsuits. Plan your return trip, as living in orbit for long periods is very difficult.
LanguageData.VGE_RefuseReply: {0} is more than happy about the current state of affairs. {1} has locked in on your Hellion and begins the attack.
LanguageData.VGE_TributeDemandPopup: {0}, the captain of {1}, is ready to receive your tribute of {2} silver. They promise to let you live if you pay the fee.\n\nThey may also accept your plea to postpone the payment by {3} days, but they will lock your Hellion engine remotely, making the aircraft unable to leave. Only paying the tribute or defeating the salvager station will unlock the Hellion engine.
LanguageData.VGE_JammerScrambledGravjumper: Your signal jammer scrambled their scanning process, giving you an additional 24 hours before {0} engages.
LanguageData.VGE_GravjumperAttacksDesc:
Despite your attempts to shake off the pursuit, the enemy Hellion Fighter {0} has successfully tracked your new landing coordinates. It has arrived in orbit and is immediately engaging your Hellion. Prepare for immediate combat.

Your aircraft will be under continuous fire from the Hellion Fighter's weapons. To survive, you must destroy the enemy Hellion Fighter engine, as well as eliminate all of its artillery turrets.

You can fight back using your Hellion's artillery, shield generators, and point defenses to withstand the bombardment. Alternatively, send a shuttle or drop pods to the enemy location to board the Hellion Fighter and destroy it from the inside. If you cannot defend yourself, you must attempt to escape its range immediately.
LanguageData.VGE_GravjumperDefeatedDesc: Enemy Hellion Fighter threat has been defeated, but the area still offers valuable loot. You can salvage its wreck to gain some valuable resources.
LanguageData.VGE_JammerScrambledCluster: Your signal jammer scrambled the signal lock, giving you an additional {0} days before the US Automated Aerospace Defense network reacquires your Hellion.
LanguageData.VGE_OrbitalClusterRelayed: US Automated Aerospace Defense has relayed your coordinates to another orbital defense battery in range. It is moving in to engage.
LanguageData.VGE_JammerScrambledGravship: Your signal jammer scrambled their scanning process, giving you an additional 24 hours before {0} engages.
LanguageData.VGE_GravshipAttacksDesc:
Despite your attempts to shake off the pursuit, the enemy Hellion {0} has successfully tracked your new landing coordinates. It has arrived in orbit and is immediately engaging your Hellion. Prepare for immediate combat.

Your aircraft will be under continuous fire from the enemy Hellion's weapons. To survive, you must destroy its Hellion engine, as well as eliminate all of its artillery turrets.

You can fight back using your Hellion's artillery, shield generators, and point defenses to withstand the bombardment. Alternatively, send a shuttle or drop pods to the enemy location to board the enemy Hellion and destroy it from the inside. If you cannot defend yourself, you must attempt to escape its range immediately.
LanguageData.VGE_RaidEnemyGravshipDesc:
An enemy Hellion called {0} has finally caught up. It has dropped into your local orbit and initiated a boarding sequence. You need to destroy its Hellion engine, as well as all of its Hellion artillery and crew, to defeat it.

Since the attackers are well equipped and prepared, it may be best to defend until your Hellion engine is able to launch again, and escape.

If you manage to defeat them, their wreck will offer valuable loot, including a reactor core.
LanguageData.VGE_GravshipEngineReadyDesc: Your Hellion engine is off cooldown. You can now perform a Hellion launch.
LanguageData.VGE_SalvagerStrongholdLetterDesc:
You have detected the distinct energy signature of a reactor core emanating from a large asteroid. Scans reveal that a well-armed faction of salvagers has claimed the rock, building a heavily defended stronghold upon it. An active enemy signal jammer within the facility prevents your Hellion from landing in close proximity, forcing you to touch down on the dangerous outskirts of the asteroid.

You must assault the base, navigate their defenses, and destroy the gravlock tether located in the center of the compound to obtain the reactor core.

Be careful, orbital locations are extremely dangerous. Equip your colonists with vacsuits. Plan your return trip, as living in orbit for long periods is very difficult.
